projection: per-trip UTM zone from mean track longitude (EPSG 326xx north / 327xx south)

excluded_train_trips.rule: train trips whose median GPS-to-reference-route alignment distance > 50.0 m (GPS and map do not line up; labels unreliable). Rows kept in train.parquet; dropped before model fitting.

model_note: Selected by grouped 5-fold CV on train (best Top-1 and macro F1, lowest log loss). Untuned configuration; replaced by the Optuna-tuned model after hyperparameter search.
hmm_config_note: Default decoder parameters; replaced after decoder tuning.
